one_line: CareBridge keeps people in control while an agent coordinates a sensitive multi-site allergy workflow.
what_it_does: Coordinates clinic, pharmacy, and daycare tasks with human judgment and approval checkpoints across sites.
leverage_rationale: Async judgement and commit tools that wait for human choices make the human-agent handoff materially more reliable than an agent scraping multiple pages.
leverage_evidence: Description explicitly says WebMCP blocks agent execution for user choice.
Claims structured output and shared workflow across three otherwise unrelated healthcare sites.
execution_rationale: The concept and packaging are coherent, but no accessible video evidence or transcript demonstrates the central workflow end to end.
execution_evidence: Devpost packaging and embedded CareBridge demo are visible.
ABOUT text describes three demos but the packet has no transcript.
impact_rationale: Sensitive, urgent healthcare coordination is a strong real use case for preserving human control while reducing repetitive work.
impact_evidence: Toddler first-allergy scenario.
Explicit focus on multi-page healthcare workflows and consequential human decisions.
creativity_rationale: The human-checkpoint pattern treats a website tool as an intentionally pausing collaborator rather than an autonomous executor.
creativity_evidence: Judgement and Commit tools are described as waiting for the person before the agent can continue.
usability_note: Human checkpoints are understandable, though multi-site healthcare coordination may be operationally demanding.
red_flags: Core end-to-end behavior is claimed rather than directly verifiable from the available packet evidence.
advance_reason: High-impact and unusually relevant WebMCP collaboration pattern despite limited execution evidence.

one_line: Reticle gives coding agents deterministic evidence for verifying real application behavior.
what_it_does: Tests running web and desktop applications across network, console, state, routing, and persistence, returning PASS/FAIL evidence.
leverage_rationale: Structured application-state and evidence inspection is substantially more reliable than a general agent deciding from screenshots or vague success responses.
leverage_evidence: Claims deterministic evidence and clear PASS/FAIL output.
Covers network requests, console errors, application state, routing, and persistence.
execution_rationale: The product framing is coherent and a demo thumbnail shows the Reticle workspace, but the packet lacks a video frame sheet, transcript, or visible completed verification result.
execution_evidence: Devpost screenshot shows Reticle workspace and agent panel.
No submitted frame sheets or transcript.
impact_rationale: AI coding agents need independent verification because self-reported completion can leave applications broken; this addresses a concrete developer problem.
impact_evidence: Explicit problem statement about agents changing files and misjudging correctness.
Verification spans multiple layers of a real application.
creativity_rationale: An agent-verification layer is a fresh, well-motivated synthesis of coding agents, browser workflows, and deterministic proof.
creativity_evidence: Central idea is that agents should not decide whether their own work is correct.
usability_note: PASS/FAIL evidence is useful, though setup and interpretation may be demanding.
red_flags: No direct end-to-end verification result is evidenced in the packet.
standouts: Clear deterministic-proof framing for agent-generated software.
advance_reason: Strong developer need and meaningful structured-agent delta; execution proof is the main uncertainty.

one_line: ShopPulse lets agents assemble bundles and manage commerce through structured WebMCP tools.
what_it_does: Provides shopper, merchant, and WebMCP surfaces for catalog browsing, bundle creation, inventory, analytics, and checkout.
leverage_rationale: Structured commerce tools improve precision and safety for bundle and inventory operations, but a capable general agent could achieve much of the same through the visible UI with friction.
leverage_evidence: Seven registered tools and live configure_bundle execution are described.
Structured tools replace screen scraping for catalog and inventory workflows.
execution_rationale: The packaging and screenshots show a coherent catalog, bundle/cart, merchant, and tool-inspector experience, though no frame sheet or transcript proves the full flow.
execution_evidence: Screenshot visibly shows storefront products, cart totals, discount, and checkout.
ABOUT text describes catalog, inventory matrix, audit drawer, and bundle execution.
impact_rationale: Commerce operators and shoppers have clear value in reliable bundle configuration and safer inventory automation.
impact_evidence: Concrete shopper and merchant workflows.
Visible 52-product catalog and live bundle/cart state.
creativity_rationale: The combination of agent-native shopping, merchant operations, and a tool studio is an ambitious commerce synthesis.
creativity_evidence: One product spans shopper copilot, merchant command, and WebMCP Studio.
usability_note: The separated modes and visible cart/audit state suggest a usable workflow.
red_flags: No submitted video frames or transcript; screenshot is packaging evidence.
standouts: Visible live bundle configuration and audit-oriented tool surface.
advance_reason: Credible product breadth and useful WebMCP delta, with enough packaging evidence to advance.

one_line: Offroof turns suspicious job offers into evidence-linked, reversible verification cases.
what_it_does: Inspects pasted or local offer text, links deterministic signals to excerpts, builds consented checklists, and records privacy-safe receipts.
leverage_rationale: Shared versioned case state, semantic read/analysis/mutation tools, consent gates, and receipts make the agent a safe collaborator rather than a UI driver.
leverage_evidence: Six page-native tools are explicitly listed.
Mutations require consent, stale versions are rejected, and calls leave visible receipts.
execution_rationale: The described case workflow is unusually complete and safety boundaries are coherent; direct video frame evidence was not available to verify every state.
execution_evidence: Screenshot preview visibly shows evidence record, browser-local mode, and WebMCP tools connected.
ABOUT text specifies import, signal excerpts, checklist, version guards, and receipts.
impact_rationale: Job seekers have a real need to distinguish urgent or manipulative offers from legitimate opportunities without exposing themselves to further risk.
impact_evidence: Concrete suspicious-job-offer audience and verification problem.
Explicitly avoids opening links, contacting employers, sending money, or declaring fraud.
creativity_rationale: The calm evidence-before-action model and explicit separation of literal text, inference, limits, and next step is a thoughtful original interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Product refuses binary safe/fraud labels and creates inspectable reversible cases.
usability_note: Privacy-clean imports, excerpt-linked signals, and reversible checklists are well matched to a stressed reviewer.
red_flags: Evidence is a fictional/privacy-clean workflow rather than live employment data.
standouts: Strong safety and privacy boundaries with shared human-agent state.
advance_reason: Among the strongest WebMCP-native safety workflows with clear audience value and unusually complete guardrails.

one_line: SafeStaff compares emergency-department staffing plans while reserving approval for the charge nurse.
what_it_does: Simulates staffing changes, compares clinical and operational trade-offs, and requires human approval with an audit trail.
leverage_rationale: Agent analysis and recommendation are separated from an explicit approval tool and recorded decision, a meaningful improvement over UI automation in a consequential setting.
leverage_evidence: submit_human_approval returns human_confirmation_required.
Only the Charge Nurse can authorize and the decision is recorded in audit trail.
execution_rationale: Screenshots show a coherent decision dashboard with strategies, projected wait, cost, risk, and approval controls; no video frame sheet or transcript confirms actual invocation.
execution_evidence: Visible three-strategy comparison and ready-for-signoff state.
Visible WebMCP Tool Console & Inspector.
impact_rationale: Emergency-department staffing is a real, high-stakes decision problem where faster scenario analysis plus human governance can provide substantial value.
impact_evidence: Concrete nurse call-out simulation and wait-time change.
Explicit charge-nurse approval guardrail.
creativity_rationale: Human-governed staffing decision support is a strong application of WebMCP, though the dashboard concept itself is familiar.
creativity_evidence: Combines imperative agent tools, scenario simulation, risk trade-offs, and role-specific approval.
usability_note: Side-by-side strategies and explicit signoff controls fit the intended professional workflow.
red_flags: Clinical validity is not established; scenario appears simulated.
standouts: Appropriate strict human-in-the-loop boundary for a high-stakes domain.
advance_reason: High-impact, well-scoped safety application with coherent visible execution.

one_line: Le Monde des Personnages IA places historical, mythological, and imaginary characters in a living map that humans and agents co-edit.
what_it_does: Lets users discover characters geographically, inspect relationships, converse with them, and use WebMCP to draft, place, connect, publish, and refine characters.
leverage_rationale: Structured draft, publication, relationship, and map tools give agents reliable shared state, but a general agent could perform much of the same UI work with friction.
leverage_evidence: Description lists separated read/create/update/publish/display tools.
Human retains approval and editorial decisions while agent edits visible map state.
execution_rationale: The map concept and Aphrodite demo packaging are coherent, but the paused preview does not demonstrate the full create-test-refine loop.
execution_evidence: Screenshot shows map with Aphrodite marker and WebMCP demo title.
ABOUT text specifies draft, placement, relationships, publication, and refinement.
impact_rationale: Students, educators, history enthusiasts, and creative explorers have a credible discovery and storytelling use case.
impact_evidence: Geographic and temporal exploration of characters is clearly defined.
Human testing and refinement supports educational/creative engagement.
creativity_rationale: A living geographic world of conversational characters, with agent-assisted editorial evolution, is memorable and genuinely novel.
creativity_evidence: Map-based relationships between historical, mythological, and imaginary AI characters.
Demo centers on creating and refining Aphrodite.
usability_note: Map discovery is intuitive, though editorial workflows may be complex.
red_flags: Full interaction and conversation quality are not directly shown in the available screenshot.
advance_reason: Exceptional creativity and credible exploratory value warrant advancement despite partial execution proof.

one_line: MetaWebMCP turns observable website workflows into bounded reusable tools that can be activated, tested, and exported.
what_it_does: Uses browser observation and accessibility models to define ToolSpecs, activate domain tools, test them, and export integrations.
leverage_rationale: The product directly addresses WebMCP adoption by converting existing websites into reusable structured agent surfaces, a capability impractical through ordinary UI driving alone.
leverage_evidence: Seven meta-tools cover analysis, contracts, activation, testing, export, state, and reset.
Same ToolSpec objects are reused for live execution, testing, and export.
execution_rationale: Architecture and workflow are unusually coherent and the screenshot shows browser workflow analysis, but no direct live export result is visible.
execution_evidence: Screenshot shows MetaWebMCP alongside a Fincaraiz property search.
ABOUT text specifies bounded contracts, activation, testing, and standalone export.
impact_rationale: The adoption bottleneck for agent-native web interaction is broad and concrete; a compatibility layer could unlock many existing sites.
impact_evidence: Targets websites that will not add native integrations overnight.
Demonstrated against public real-estate search workflow.
creativity_rationale: A system that builds WebMCP itself from observable workflows is an original and ambitious meta-level concept.
creativity_evidence: MetaWebMCP is explicitly WebMCP that builds WebMCP.
Live and exported representations share reviewed contracts.
usability_note: Bounded contracts and testing help, but building tools from arbitrary sites may require expertise.
red_flags: No public repository is listed, and the frame-sheet files were not available for direct review.
standouts: Most direct attempt to solve WebMCP adoption from the compatibility side.
advance_reason: Transformative WebMCP leverage and strong ambition outweigh incomplete direct execution evidence.

one_line: EqualTrace audits whether WebMCP agents receive the same safety protections as visual and assistive users.
what_it_does: Runs a deterministic account-deletion scenario through three routes, compares six protection groups, and issues a parity receipt only after approved repair and fresh evidence.
leverage_rationale: Native invocation is treated as a first-class route in a shared trace model, enabling deterministic parity testing and bounded repair that ordinary UI driving cannot provide comparably.
leverage_evidence: Screenshot compares Visual, Assistive, and WebMCP Agent routes with 6/6 versus 2/6 protection scores.
ABOUT text specifies approval-bound one-use repair and SHA-256 parity receipt.
execution_rationale: The visible dashboard demonstrates a concrete failure comparison and coherent repair/proof workflow, though full rerun evidence is not visible.
execution_evidence: Visible fictional deletion scenario, seed, route comparison, missing consequences/consent/undo for agent.
Demo is an 80-second titled video and screenshot clearly shows the product state.
impact_rationale: Protection parity is a critical, concrete release concern for consequential agent-operated websites and directly catches failures outcome-only tests miss.
impact_evidence: Compares consent, disclosure, feedback, reversibility, and recovery.
Central claim identifies successful deletion with failed safety contract.
creativity_rationale: The framing of agent success as a safety-contract failure, with three-route parity and bounded repair, is highly original and deeply pursued.
creativity_evidence: One action/three routes/one protection contract model.
Repair appears only after human approval and disappears after use or invalidation.
usability_note: Deterministic scenario, reset, and explicit route comparison make a complex audit legible.
red_flags: Scenario is fictional and local-only, so production generalization remains unproven.
standouts: Clear safety thesis backed by a concrete comparative artifact.
advance_reason: Exceptional WebMCP-specific safety insight, strong visible execution, and high relevance.

one_line: CommonGround lets people and browser agents draft and inspect neighborhood plans without giving agents final authority.
what_it_does: Models a Riverside ward budget and projects, lets humans set priorities, and lets an agent create and simulate visible proposals for approval.
leverage_rationale: Shared plan state, visible agent drafts, simulation, and human approval materially improve consequential planning over an agent operating opaque UI steps.
leverage_evidence: Description separates agent planning from human execution and approval.
Visible activity entry, budget, protected priorities, and draft proposal are structured state.
execution_rationale: The screenshot shows a coherent planning dashboard with map, draft, budget, guardrail, and heat metric, but no transcript confirms the full agent call sequence.
execution_evidence: Visible Agent Draft with cost, heat coverage, protected youth center, and budget left.
ABOUT text describes goal selection, priorities, draft, simulation, and approval.
impact_rationale: Municipal and community planners have a real need to compare budget-constrained projects while keeping decisions accountable to people.
impact_evidence: Concrete fixed-budget Riverside ward scenario with six projects.
Explicit consequential-decision and developing-municipality framing.
creativity_rationale: The combination of civic planning, agent drafts, protected priorities, and visible deliberation is a fresh interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Agent produces an inspectable plan rather than silently executing a neighborhood decision.
usability_note: Budget and impact metrics make trade-offs inspectable, though civic planning inputs could become complex.
red_flags: Uses a fictional ward and illustrative metrics; real planning validity is not established.
advance_reason: Credible, socially useful collaborative planning experience with strong visible product coherence.

one_line: ShuiSpace is a collaborative room designer where agent layout proposals wait for human accept or reject decisions.
what_it_does: Edits room geometry and furniture through shared actions, with collision checks, measurements, budgets, undo, and human-gated layout proposals.
leverage_rationale: The agent and person use the same geometry-aware actions, and an async proposal can pause until the human inspects and decides—behavior a generic UI agent cannot reliably replicate.
leverage_evidence: Nineteen shared actions hit the same collision checks and undo entries.
propose_layout stages translucent ghosts and does not return until Accept or Reject.
execution_rationale: The screenshot shows a coherent 3D room editor, room list, and natural-language prompts; the central accept/reject behavior is claimed but not visibly demonstrated.
execution_evidence: Visible 3D/isometric room with furniture and room-selection panel.
ABOUT text specifies geometry, costs, collision checks, and reversible proposals.
impact_rationale: Home renovators and room planners have a concrete desire for spatially grounded layout suggestions that account for dimensions, passage, and budget.
impact_evidence: Prompts address reading use and lamp cost.
Product uses actual room geometry rather than image-only suggestions.
creativity_rationale: Making the page and agent the same geometry-aware tool, including a tool call that waits for human review, is a fresh and memorable interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Shared actions, staged ghosts, refusal recovery, and accept/reject return semantics are pursued together.
usability_note: Direct manipulation plus natural-language proposals and visible geometry feedback is well matched to the task.
red_flags: The packet's referenced frame sheet was unavailable at the specified path, limiting direct motion verification.
standouts: Excellent shared-state and human-gated proposal semantics for a creative tool.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP leverage and distinctive collaborative interaction with credible visible product evidence.
